payload.summary: Prepare releases using the current release.npm-exact-artifact workflow: one version-derived candidate, published 0.3 compatibility and post-completion main promotion.
payload.verification: The full local suite remains available through test:all after an explicit build. CI selects complementary source, platform, package and historical release-tool coverage, while preserving all common benchmark samples and exact tarball checks.
payload.publication: Only the maintainer may publish the reviewed tarball after explicit final approval, green current main and reviewed-PR byte equality. Agents never publish.
